body.message:
Good morning,

Yes, this apartment is available from 29th September. The rate for a 1-month stay (30 nights) is AED 9,000.

Please also note that a refundable security/damage deposit of AED 1,500 is required.

The refundable damage deposit will be reimbursed within 7–14 working days after check-out, subject to a final inspection of the property. The deposit will be refunded in full via credit card or bank transfer, provided there are no damages or outstanding charges.
